title: Update Bun 1.4-compatible dependencies
description: Review outdated packages after the Bun 1.4 migration. Apply only compatible patch/minor dependency upgrades, regenerate the lockfile with Bun 1.4, and verify the product. Do not introduce the breaking OpenAI 7 or TypeScript 7 majors without separate compatibility work.
acceptance: Compatible patch/minor updates are intentionally selected from bun outdated and recorded in package.json and bun.lock.
No dependency is removed unless its imports and build/runtime use are proven absent.
bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun test, typecheck, Biome, build, and ledger validation pass under Bun 1.4.
notes: bun:sqlite is already the production backend. node:sqlite is a deliberate Node dev/CI fallback, not an npm dependency to remove. OpenAI 7 and TypeScript 7 are excluded as major upgrades.
